'''Lyla''' (Japanese: '''ライラ''' ''Lyla'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[JN110|Narrowing the Chaser Chase!]]''. She is one of the Challengers taking part in [[Project Mew]].

==History==
[[File:Lyla and Sterling.png|250px|left|thumb|Lyla and Sterling]]
Lyla was first seen approaching [[Sterling]] after he had defeated two other Challengers whilst taking part in the battle royale [[Field Research|Trial Mission]] at [[Sea Mauville]]. Lyla proposed teaming up with Sterling to pass the mission, which he accepted. They continued to explore Sea Mauville, defeating fellow challengers and evading the {{p|Roselia}} and {{p|Magby}} that [[Danika]] unleashed to make the mission harder.

Later, they came across [[Goh]] and [[Horace]] and made them think that Lyla's {{p|Liepard}} was injured. This was soon revealed to be a trick, allowing Sterling and Lyla to attack Horace's {{p|Gardevoir}}, causing it serious [[damage]]. Lyla teamed up with Sterling to battle [[Goh's Inteleon]], but Goh was successful in defeating Liepard, causing Lyla to fail the mission. Lyla then joined with all the other challengers when Danika and received a video message from [[Quillon]].

In ''[[JN113|Chasing to the Finish!]]'', Lyla appeared at the [[Split-Decision Ruins]], where {{Gary}} and Goh were taking part in a Project Mew mission. Afterwards, she watched as they took on a {{p|Regidrago}} and {{p|Regieleki}}, which they proceeded to catch, completing the mission.
